source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Room for 6 models, and only ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY models may embark. JUMP PACK models and the TRIUMPH OF SAINT KATHERINE may not embark. As you begin Declare Battle Formations, you may pick one of your BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD, DOMINION SQUAD or SISTERS NOVITIATE SQUAD units and separate it into two units as close to equal in size as possible, noting which models make up each. If that unit has the Cherub ability, just one of the two may use it during the battle; note which one. One of the two must begin the battle embarked in this model; the other may begin embarked in a different TRANSPORT or be set up on its own.

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
